title: fix(rbi): drop invalid overload sigs from Workflow.upsert_memo

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+Fixed the `Workflow.upsert_memo` RBI signature so `srb tc` no longer rejects it with `Malformed sig` (srb.help/5003).

@@ -298,18 +298,6 @@ module Temporalio::Workflow
     sig { returns(T::Hash[T.nilable(String), Temporalio::Workflow::Definition::Update]) }
     def update_handlers; end
 
-    sig do
-      overload.params(
-        hash: T::Hash[T.any(Symbol, String), T.nilable(Object)],
-        event_groups: T.nilable(T::Array[Temporalio::Workflow::EventGroup])
-      ).void
-    end
-    sig do
-      overload.params(
-        event_groups: T.nilable(T::Array[Temporalio::Workflow::EventGroup]),
-        memo: T.nilable(Object)
-      ).void
-    end
     sig do
       params(
         hash: T.nilable(T::Hash[T.any(Symbol, String), T.nilable(Object)]),
